<parameter name="content"># checkout-service

Next.js 14 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind, Prisma on Postgres.

## Commands

- Unit tests: `npm run test:unit`. Use this by default.
- `npm test` runs the Playwright E2E suite. It fails unless the dev server (`npm run dev`) is already running.
- Migrations: always run `./scripts/migrate.sh`. Never run `prisma migrate` directly, because it breaks the shadow database CI relies on.

## Rules

- Money is always integer cents. Never use floats for monetary values, in calculations, types, or DB columns. A float-rounding bug once corrupted invoices.
- Use no default exports. Use named exports only.
- Colocate Zod schemas next to the route handlers that use them.
- API routes authenticate with a custom `X-Session-Token` header, not `Authorization: Bearer`. Read `docs/api.md` before touching auth or adding API routes.

Otherwise follow standard TypeScript conventions. The full style guide is `docs/style-guide.md`. Consult it only for questions the rules above don't answer.
</parameter>
